summary_rationale: Intuitive Surgical operates an entrenched installed-base surgical robotics ecosystem with 12,094 da Vinci systems and 1,152 Ion endoluminal systems worldwide as of September 30, 2026, generating roughly 84% recurring revenue from single-use and limited-life instruments, accessories, service contracts, and operating leases. Across FY2016 to FY2025, revenue compounded from $2.70B to $10.06B (+15.7% 9-year CAGR), while FY2025 GAAP operating margin reached 29.3% ($2.95B), operating cash flow reached $3.03B, and free cash flow totaled $2.49B on a debt-free balance sheet ($9.03B cash and investments at YE 2025; $6.80B at Q3 2026 after $2.94B in Q3 share repurchases) with 18.5% ROIC. The business earns COMPOUNDER_PASS on its clinical evidence moat, surgeon training lock-in, and da Vinci 5 upgrade cycle (870 systems placed in FY2025; 315 in Q3 2026). KPI health is set to PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unblemished PASS due to three verifiable watchpoints: U.S. da Vinci procedure growth moderating to ~10% in Q3 2026 amid GLP-1 bariatric substitution and ACA subsidy headwinds, 65–120 bps of tariff pressure on gross margins, and the $450M Q3 2026 antitrust class-action settlement alongside ongoing third-party instrument repair appeals and benign-procedure instrument price recalibrations.
